nodes.label: RPG AI Server
nodes.rationale: Two-server design: a Python FastAPI AI agent server and a Next.js web server coordinated through shared Redis; documents data flow, trigger system, session lifecycle and 22 open questions.

nodes.label: Shared Redis (Upstash) Data Layout
nodes.rationale: input:queue, trigger:last/busy, games:{sid}:* state/counter/event, output:{sid}, rag:{sid}:{idx} keys coordinate both servers; TTL reset to 1h per action.

nodes.label: GamePage Detail View
nodes.rationale: Designed but not implemented detail route /game/[uuid]; depends on open issues #80,#81,#82,#84,#85 (#81,#82 still open).

nodes.label: graphify Knowledge Graph
nodes.rationale: Auto-extracted graph: 2,608 nodes, 3,143 edges, 188 communities; god nodes classifyError (54), tryApiRoute (22), Upstash Redis SDK (22), validateJWTMiddleware (20).

nodes.label: Multi-Database Architecture
nodes.rationale: Each data type assigned to best store: Neon Postgres (catalog), MongoDB+Mongoose (nested docs), Upstash Redis (cache+queue), Supabase Storage (images), Convex (opt-in realtime).

nodes.label: Game Fetch Pipeline (utilities/gameFetchPipeline.ts)
nodes.rationale: Batch queue + poll loop with verified gap terminator and 5s wall-clock budget; judged sound in LOOPS.md (W3 minor noise).

nodes.label: lib/retry.ts Retry Wrapper
nodes.rationale: Bounded N-try retry (default 3) with no jitter; W1 finding flags greedy retry of 4xx/5xx.

nodes.label: hooks/useIdempotentRequest.ts
nodes.rationale: UUID v7 + AbortController single-retry idempotent request; W2 finding flags same-key concurrency race.

nodes.label: ioredis (legacy) dependency
nodes.rationale: Legacy redis client being removed in open issue #94; migrated to Upstash in #93.

nodes.label: React Query (@tanstack/react-query)
nodes.rationale: 100% local useState caused repeated API requests, duplicate loading logic, and inconsistent data across navigations; centralized server-state caching via React Query was chosen to separate server state from UI state instead of Context.

nodes.label: Unified useForm Hook
nodes.rationale: Three near-identical form hooks (hooks/form.ts, hooks/gameForm.ts, lib/useGamesForm.ts) created a maintenance burden; consolidated into a single generic typed hook (hooks/useForm.ts) with useGameForm factory to enforce DRY.

nodes.label: Bottleneck.Group (per-key limiting)
nodes.rationale: Manual Map of Bottleneck limiters per IP caused an unbounded memory leak; Bottleneck.Group (v2+ API) provides automatic per-key limiter creation, reuse, and cleanup.

nodes.label: Clerk Authentication
nodes.rationale: Manual jsonwebtoken verification duplicated Clerk's responsibility and referenced nonexistent Neon/MongoDB JWT validators; Clerk is the sole auth provider while Neon and MongoDB use native connection-string auth.
